memories.summary: Mara arrived in Lagos on the night of 2026-07-08 (Toronto departure 2026-07-09 local) and is staying at her mother's house in Surulere; Chidi met her at arrivals.

entities.name: Surulere
entities.description: Lagos neighbourhood where Mara's mother's house is

memories.summary: On 2026-07-11 Mara saw her mother for the first time in person; her mother is thinner but stood and held her face, and is steady on her new atrial-fibrillation medication.

entities.name: Adaeze Okonkwo
entities.description: Mara's mother in Lagos, managing atrial fibrillation

memories.summary: Dr. Tunde Adeyemi is an old family friend and doctor who informally checks in on Mara's mother in Lagos; he has known the family since Chidi was a baby.

entities.name: Dr. Tunde Adeyemi
entities.description: family-friend doctor who looks in on Mara's mother in Lagos; distinct from Mara's uncle Tunde Bakare

memories.summary: On seeing her mother again on 2026-07-11 Mara broke down when her mother held her face and called her 'her stubborn one.'
Chidi met Mara at Lagos arrivals on her 2026-07-09 night landing holding a sign reading 'OYINBO' to tease her.
Tunde Bakare is Mara's uncle, her mother's younger brother in Lagos; he drives a danfo and is around the family constantly. He is a different person from Dr. Tunde Adeyemi the family-friend doctor.

entities.name: Tunde Bakare
entities.description: Mara's uncle (her mother's younger brother) in Lagos; distinct from Dr. Tunde Adeyemi the doctor

memories.summary: Mara's mother is being treated for atrial fibrillation in Lagos by both a hospital cardiologist and, informally, the family-friend doctor Dr. Tunde Adeyemi (noted 2026-07-11).

entities.name: Dr. Tunde Adeyemi
entities.description: family-friend doctor; distinct from uncle Tunde Bakare

memories.summary: Mara felt 'home in the strange way,' jetlagged and happy, during her first days back in Lagos in July 2026.
